tools.name: list_exercises
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to see which bodyweight exercises Upfit can run. Returns the enabled exercises with Upfit's own difficulty rating (1 easiest to 9 hardest) and, where Upfit documents it, how you stand to the phone (facing it, side-on to it, or on the floor). Optional difficulty filters.

tools.name: about_upfit
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what Upfit is, how it works, or what it cannot check. Returns a short description and links to Upfit's own explanation pages.
